intro: The same war, the same fact sheet, written again by the two remaining models with a revised prompt, then translated by the same model with a revised German prompt. Each new book was also translated with the old German prompt, so the two translation prompts can be compared on the same text. Timings ran while another job loaded the machine; compare quality, not speed.
summary:
Book prompt: the bias got stronger, but so did invented facts, in both models. Gemma moved the sacking to the capital and gave the Saryhorde's dead to the Keshband; Qwen let the Keshband suffer setbacks they never had. Qwen followed "use digits"; Gemma kept years as digits but wrote every count as words. The old prompt's general rules ("use only the facts in the fact sheet… you may invent feelings, images and small details that carry no name and no number") kept the facts tighter. Best next step: keep those rules and add the new digits and no-new-facts lines.

Translation prompt: it helps Gemma where it aimed: epithets come out in German ("Bayan dem Unsichtbaren Weber") and the articles are consistent ("die Keshband"). Grammar slips remain, and one count came out garbled ("vierhundertelfund und elf"). For Qwen the two prompts give nearly the same text, with the same errors.

comments.gemma4-e4b/Saryhorde: Strong, fitting bias. Invents a 'siege' and says the Keshband were 'compelled to terms'. Counts written as words despite the rule.
comments.gemma4-e4b/Keshband: Facts worse than with the old prompt: says the capital Bortebulak was sacked (it was Bortedag), gives the 408 Saryhorde dead to the Keshband, invents a 'rebellion'.
comments.qwen3-8b/Saryhorde: Digits used. Says the Keshband struck first (the Saryhorde declared war) and that 'by 911 the tide had turned', though the Keshband won every battle.
comments.qwen3-8b/Keshband: Needed 3 tries (it added a title line). Invents 'a few setbacks' for the Keshband and skips the battles of 906 and 911.
comments.gemma4-e4b/Saryhorde/de_v2: German epithets and articles, idiomatic. Slips: 'zufügten', 'Bayans des Unsichtbaren Weber', and a garbled count 'vierhundertelfund und elf'.
comments.gemma4-e4b/Saryhorde/de_v1: Leaves 'Bayan the Unseen Weaver' and 'Tsetseg the Second' in English. Counts correct.
comments.gemma4-e4b/Keshband/de_v2: Good: consistent 'die Keshband', German epithets. 'unter den Irren' (madmen) is wrong.
comments.gemma4-e4b/Keshband/de_v1: Wavers between 'das' and 'die Keshband'; 'ein Torheit'. Turned counts into digits.
comments.qwen3-8b/Saryhorde/de_v1: Almost the same text and the same errors as with the new prompt.
comments.qwen3-8b/Keshband/de_v1: Same as the new prompt, plus 'zu herauszufordern'.
